faq.q: What is the best class in Azeroth Survivors?
What is the best Warrior build?
How do talents work in Azeroth Survivors?
faq.a: Runs earn class talent experience that you spend in Armory → Talents. The current menu caps you at 51 points, a new row opens for every 5 points spent in a tree, and respecs are free.

faq.q: Can you play Azeroth Survivors in a browser for free?
faq.a: Yes. The original by Aethus runs free at wow.aethus.pl in a WebGPU-capable browser, and the same page links a Windows download.
Yes. Pick your hero, then press Co-op beside Enter to host a room or join with a code; the current client supports a party of up to five.

faq.q: How do I move my save to another browser or PC?
faq.a: Open Options → Saves and export a .sav file, then import it on the new browser or device. Import replaces the progress there instead of merging, so export both sides first if you want to keep both.
It needs WebGPU and a usable graphics adapter. Update the browser, turn on hardware acceleration and let the first game-data download finish; the fixes page matches each error message.
